pipelines.name: Bench image

steps.name: Smoke - the CLI runs
steps.run: docker run --rm hoglake-bench:ci --help

steps.name: Smoke - CostBench CLI and writable query cache
steps.run:
docker run --rm --network none hoglake-bench:ci costbench --help
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint python hoglake-bench:ci -c '
from hoglake_bench.costbench.__main__ import build_parser
args = build_parser().parse_args(["run", "--trino-url", "http://localhost:8080", "--hourly-usd", "0", "--output", "/work/run.jsonl"])
args.query_cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
args.query_cache.write_text("cache write probe")
'

steps.name: Smoke - non-root, no host virtualenv
steps.run:
uid=$(docker run --rm --entrypoint id hoglake-bench:ci -u)
echo "uid=$uid"
[ "$uid" != "0" ]
if docker run --rm --entrypoint find hoglake-bench:ci / -name .venv -maxdepth 6 | grep .; then
  echo "::error::image contains a .venv"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Smoke - pyhoglake comes from this commit
steps.run:
want=$(grep -m1 '^version = ' pyhoglake/pyproject.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
got=$(docker run --rm --entrypoint python hoglake-bench:ci -c 'import pyhoglake; print(pyhoglake.__version__)')
origin=$(docker run --rm --entrypoint python hoglake-bench:ci -c \
  'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.distribution("pyhoglake").read_text("direct_url.json"))')
echo "pyproject=$want image=$got origin=$origin"
[ "$want" = "$got" ]
case "$origin" in *file:///src/pyhoglake*) : ;; *) echo "::error::pyhoglake was not installed from the sibling tree"; exit 1 ;; esac

steps.name: Report the pinnable ref
steps.run:
digest=$(docker buildx imagetools inspect --raw ghcr.io/posthog/hoglake-bench:${{ github.sha }} | sha256sum | awk '{print "sha256:"$1}')
{
  echo "### Bench image published"
  echo
  echo '```'
  echo "ghcr.io/posthog/hoglake-bench:${{ github.sha }}"
  echo "ghcr.io/posthog/hoglake-bench@${digest}"
  echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

pipelines.name: CI python

with.filters:
python:
  - "pyhoglake/**"
  - "pyhoglake-variant-codec/**"
  - "hedgerow/**"
  - "millrace/**"
  - "bench/**"
  # The uv workspace root: one lock for all four trees.
  - "pyproject.toml"
  - "uv.lock"
  # The OpenAPI spec is the wire contract the clients
  # conform to.
  - "server/src/main/resources/openapi/hoglake.yaml"
  # Server files the client's parity tests parse, so that a
  # server-only change to them reds here rather than on the
  # next unrelated pyhoglake PR: test_variant_ddl.py reads
  # VariantShredding.kt's limits, vocabularies and column
  # messages, ColumnTrees.kt's container message (ops.py
  # raises it), Identifiers.kt's cap, Model.kt's ColType
  # vocabulary (as test_transforms.py and test_nested.py
  # read Model.kt too), and the request seeds of the
  # shredding fuzz corpus (its JDK check also reads
  # build.gradle.kts and the Dockerfile, which change with
  # every dependency bump and are left out: only a JDK
  # downgrade could red that check). dependabot.yml is in the
  # filter too:
  # test_pyarrow_floor.test_the_latest_pyarrow_canary_keeps_the_dependency_cooldown
  # holds the pyarrow canary's cooldown to its uv cooldown.
  - "server/src/main/kotlin/com/posthog/hoglake/model/Model.kt"
  - "server/src/main/kotlin/com/posthog/hoglake/service/VariantShredding.kt"
  - "server/src/main/kotlin/com/posthog/hoglake/service/ColumnTrees.kt"
  - "server/src/main/kotlin/com/posthog/hoglake/service/Identifiers.kt"
  - "server/src/test/resources/com/posthog/hoglake/fuzz/VariantShreddingFuzzTestInputs/**"
  - ".github/dependabot.yml"
  - ".github/workflows/ci-python.yml"
  - ".github/workflows/pyhoglake-checks.yml"
  - ".github/workflows/python-live.yml"
  - ".github/workflows/variant-codec-wheels.yml"
  - "ci/**"
# What the codec's wheels are built and tested from, the
# lock (pyarrow, the test env) included.
codec:
  - "pyhoglake-variant-codec/**"
  - "uv.lock"
  - ".github/workflows/variant-codec-wheels.yml"
  - "ci/variant-codec-wheel.sh"
  - "ci/variant_codec_smoke.py"
# What a codec release is built from.
codec-source:
  - "pyhoglake-variant-codec/src/**"
  - "pyhoglake-variant-codec/Cargo.*"
  - "pyhoglake-variant-codec/pyproject.toml"
  - "pyhoglake-variant-codec/rust-toolchain.toml"

steps.name: Require Python checks and live suites

test "$CHANGES_RESULT" = success &&
  test "$CLIENT_RESULT" = success &&

steps.name: A codec change has a new or .dev version
steps.run:
version() { git show "$1:pyhoglake-variant-codec/pyproject.toml" | grep -m1 '^version = ' | cut -d'"' -f2; }
new=$(version HEAD) old=$(version HEAD^1)
[ -n "$new" ] && [ -n "$old" ] || { echo "::error::cannot read the codec's version"; exit 1; }
case "$new" in *.dev*) exit 0 ;; esac
if [ "$new" = "$old" ]; then
  echo "::error::pyhoglake-variant-codec changed but is still $new: bump its version, or make it .dev"
  exit 1
fi
uv sync --locked

steps.name: Lint (ruff, pinned in dev deps)

uv run ruff check .

steps.name: Tests
steps.run: uv run pytest -m "not integration" -q

pipelines.name: ECR release

gate.if:
github.repository == 'PostHog/hoglake' && (
  github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
  github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
  (
    github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
    github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
    github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository
  )
)

steps.name: Read the test gates
steps.run:
if [[ $EVENT == pull_request ]]; then
  echo "Dry run for ${PR_SHA}. Nothing goes to ECR."
  {
    echo "publish=true"
    echo "dry-run=true"
    echo "sha=${PR_SHA}"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ $EVENT == workflow_dispatch ]]; then
  if [[ $DISPATCH_DRY_RUN != true && $DISPATCH_REF != refs/heads/main ]]; then
    echo "::error::A dispatch on ${DISPATCH_REF} must set dry_run. Only refs/heads/main can publish to ECR."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ $DISPATCH_DRY_RUN == true ]]; then
    echo "Dry run for ${DISPATCH_SHA} on ${DISPATCH_REF}. Nothing goes to ECR."
    {
      echo "publish=true"
      echo "dry-run=true"
      echo "sha=${DISPATCH_SHA}"
    } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    exit 0
  fi
  # A real dispatch reads the same test gates as a workflow_run.
  # A person must not publish a commit whose tests failed.
  echo "Release for ${DISPATCH_SHA} on ${DISPATCH_REF}."
  {
    .release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh gate "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$DISPATCH_SHA"
    echo "dry-run=false"
    echo "sha=${DISPATCH_SHA}"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
{
  .release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh gate "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$RUN_SHA"
  echo "dry-run=false"
  echo "sha=${RUN_SHA}"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Require publish role
steps.run:
if [[ -z "$PUBLISH_ROLE" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Set the repository secret HOGLAKE_AWS_ECR_PUBLISH_IAM_ROLE to the GitHub OIDC publish role ARN"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Start the local registry (dry run)
steps.run:
docker run -d --name registry -p 127.0.0.1:5000:5000 \
  registry:3@sha256:01cd312e67026f06f5d89c3e133a4a9adc7cb9eeb9b1194e0b2954dfd770efd2
for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
  if curl -fsS -m 2 http://127.0.0.1:5000/v2/ >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "::error::the local registry did not start"
exit 1

steps.name: Select the registry
steps.run:
if [[ $DRY_RUN == true ]]; then
  echo "value=127.0.0.1:5000" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  [[ -n $ECR_REGISTRY ]] || { echo "::error::the ECR login gave no registry"; exit 1; }
  echo "value=${ECR_REGISTRY}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Check the tag read failure rule (dry run)
steps.run:
if out=$(.release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh select 127.0.0.1:5999 "$SHA" hoglake-server hoglake-webui); then
  echo "::error::select did not stop when the registry was not available"
  exit 1
fi
[[ -z $out ]] || { echo "::error::select gave output after a failure: ${out}"; exit 1; }

steps.name: Select the release tag
steps.run:
.release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh select "$REGISTRY" "$SHA" hoglake-server hoglake-webui \
  | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Build stamp
steps.run: echo "value=${TAG:1:8}T${TAG:9:4}Z" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Check the partial release rule (dry run)
steps.run:
out=$(.release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh select "$REGISTRY" "$SHA" hoglake-server hoglake-webui)
echo "$out"
want=$(printf 'tag=%s\npush-hoglake-server=false\npush-hoglake-webui=true' "$TAG")
[[ $out == "$want" ]] || { echo "::error::a rerun did not repair the partial release"; exit 1; }
if .release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh check-release "$REGISTRY" "$TAG" "$SHA" hoglake-server hoglake-webui; then
  echo "::error::the release check passed with the webui image missing"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Verify the release
steps.run: .release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh check-release "$REGISTRY" "$TAG" "$SHA" hoglake-server hoglake-webui

steps.name: Check the rerun rule (dry run)
steps.run:
out=$(.release-tools/.github/scripts/ecr-release.sh select "$REGISTRY" "$SHA" hoglake-server hoglake-webui)
echo "$out"
want=$(printf 'tag=%s\npush-hoglake-server=false\npush-hoglake-webui=false' "$TAG")
[[ $out == "$want" ]] || { echo "::error::a rerun did not use the existing release"; exit 1; }

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  if [[ $DRY_RUN == true ]]; then
    echo "### ECR release (dry run, local registry)"
  else
    echo "### ECR release"
  fi
  echo
  echo '```'
  for name in hoglake-server hoglake-webui; do
    digest=$(crane digest "${REGISTRY}/${name}:${TAG}")
    echo "${name}:${TAG}@${digest}"
  done
  echo "revision ${SHA}"
  echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Fuzz all targets
steps.run:
case "$FUZZ_SECONDS" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "fuzz_seconds must be an integer, got '$FUZZ_SECONDS'" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$SWEEP_SECONDS" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "sweep_seconds must be an integer, got '$SWEEP_SECONDS'" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
# tee for the triage job below; bash runs with pipefail, so
# the gradle exit code survives the pipe.
./gradlew --no-daemon fuzz \
  -PfuzzSeconds="$FUZZ_SECONDS" -PfuzzSweepSeconds="$SWEEP_SECONDS" 2>&1 | tee ../fuzz-run.log

steps.name: Collect findings
steps.run:
git status --porcelain server/src/test/resources/com/posthog/hoglake/fuzz \
  | tee fuzz-findings.txt

steps.name: Fuzz encode_json and decode
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
cargo +nightly install cargo-fuzz --locked --version 0.13.2
cargo +nightly fuzz run encode_json -- -max_total_time=600
cargo +nightly fuzz run decode -- -max_total_time=600

steps.name: Extract evidence
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Failed targets"
  grep -E "^> Task :fuzz.+ FAILED" findings/fuzz-run.log || echo "(none parsed)"
  echo
  echo "## Crash stacks"
  grep -B1 -A6 "FuzzTestFindingException\|== Java Exception" findings/fuzz-run.log | head -80
  echo
  echo "## Dedup tokens"
  grep -oE "DEDUP_TOKEN: [0-9a-f]+" findings/fuzz-run.log | sort -u
  echo
  echo "## New corpus files"
  head -20 findings/fuzz-findings.txt 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "## Tail of run"
  tail -30 findings/fuzz-run.log
} > evidence.md
grep -oE "DEDUP_TOKEN: [0-9a-f]+" findings/fuzz-run.log \
  | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u > tokens.txt
cat evidence.md

with.system-prompt: You triage nightly Jazzer fuzz failures for the hoglake lakehouse catalog. REAL means a genuine finding: a FuzzTestFindingException whose cause lands in com.posthog.hoglake code, usually with a DEDUP_TOKEN and a crash file written into the seed-corpus directories. FLAKE means infrastructure: runner OOM or eviction, network or dependency-download failure, gradle daemon or cache trouble, a timeout with no crash stack. Answer with a first line of exactly "VERDICT: REAL", "VERDICT: FLAKE" or "VERDICT: UNCLEAR", then a short rationale naming the evidence you used.

steps.name: Open or bump the tracking issue
steps.run:
printf '%s\n' "$RESPONSE" > verdict.txt
# ${var:-} default, not `|| echo`: the pipeline's last command
# succeeds even when grep matches nothing, so the fallback
# would fire only under pipefail — make it unconditional.
verdict=$(grep -m1 -oE "VERDICT: (REAL|FLAKE|UNCLEAR)" verdict.txt | awk '{print $2}' || true)
verdict=${verdict:-UNCLEAR}
echo "verdict: $verdict"
if [ "$verdict" != "REAL" ]; then
  echo "No issue filed ($verdict). Evidence and rationale stay in this run's log."
  exit 0
fi
created=0
while read -r token; do
  [ -n "$token" ] || continue
  existing=$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open \
    --search "in:body $token" --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
  if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
    gh issue comment "$existing" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
      --body "Reproduced again by the nightly fuzz run: $RUN_URL (dedup token \`$token\`)."
    echo "bumped #$existing for $token"
    continue
  fi
  if [ "$created" -ge 3 ]; then
    echo "issue cap reached; $token stays in the run log"
    continue
  fi
  target=$(grep -B40 "DEDUP_TOKEN: $token" findings/fuzz-run.log \
    | grep -oE "[A-Za-z]+FuzzTest" | tail -1)
  {
    echo "The nightly fuzz run found a crash that automated triage classified as a real finding."
    echo
    echo "- Run: $RUN_URL (crash inputs in the \`fuzz-findings-*\` artifact)"
    echo "- Dedup token: \`$token\`"
    echo
    echo "## Evidence"
    echo '```'
    cat evidence.md
    echo '```'
    echo
    echo "## Triage rationale (model output — verify before trusting)"
    sed -n '1,15p' verdict.txt
    echo
    echo "## Promotion rule (fuzzing.md)"
    echo "A real finding becomes a committed corpus entry, a pinned regression test in \`:test\`, and, when the surface is cross-language, a \`bounds_vectors.json\` entry (the bounds codec) or a \`variant_shredding_vectors.json\` entry with \`EXPECTED_COUNT\` bumped on both sides (\`VariantShreddingFuzzTest\`). See the promotion rule in docs/fuzzing.md."
  } > issue-body.md
  gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --title "Nightly fuzz: ${target:-unknown target} crash (dedup $token)" \
    --body-file issue-body.md
  created=$((created + 1))
done < tokens.txt
if [ ! -s tokens.txt ]; then
  echo "REAL verdict but no dedup tokens parsed; filing a single untokened issue"
  {
    echo "The nightly fuzz run failed and automated triage classified it as a real finding, but no DEDUP_TOKEN was parsed — read the run."
    echo
    echo "- Run: $RUN_URL"
    echo
    echo '```'
    cat evidence.md
    echo '```'
  } > issue-body.md
  gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --title "Nightly fuzz: unclassified crash ($(date -u +%Y-%m-%d))" \
    --body-file issue-body.md
fi

steps.name: No duplicate versions, no edits to shipped migrations
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin main
MIG=server/src/main/resources/db/migration

# Append-only: every migration file on CURRENT main must be
# byte-identical here. Only additions are allowed. The
# `migration-chain-override` label skips this half for a PR
# that repairs a chain no database can have applied (two
# PRs each added the same version; the second to merge left
# main unable to boot, and its file had to be renumbered).
# The duplicate-version half below never skips.
bad=$(git diff --name-status origin/main HEAD -- "$MIG" | grep -v '^A' || true)
if [ -n "$bad" ] && [ "$OVERRIDE" != "true" ]; then
  echo "::error::Migration chain is append-only; changed or removed vs latest main:"
  echo "$bad"
  echo "::error::A repair of an unapplied chain may carry the migration-chain-override label."
  exit 1
elif [ -n "$bad" ]; then
  echo "::warning::migration-chain-override label present; append-only check skipped for:"
  echo "$bad"
fi

# Version collision: one basename per V<number> across the
# union of latest main and this branch. A file this branch
# removes from main (only possible under the override) leaves
# the union, or a repair of a duplicate on main could never
# pass its own check.
removed=$(git diff --name-only --no-renames --diff-filter=D origin/main HEAD -- "$MIG" | sed 's:.*/::')
{ git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- "$MIG" | sed 's:.*/::' | grep -v -x -F -f <(printf '%s\n' "$removed")
  git ls-files -- "$MIG" | sed 's:.*/::'; } |
  grep -E '^V[0-9]+__[^/]+\.sql$' | sort -u |
  sed -E 's/^V([0-9]+)__.*/\1 &/' | sort -n |
  awk '$1 == prev { printf "::error::Duplicate migration version V%s: %s and %s\n", $1, last, $2; dup = 1 }
       { prev = $1; last = $2 }
       END { exit dup }'

# Ordering: a new migration must be numbered ABOVE everything
# already on main. Flyway (outOfOrder=false, our setting)
# refuses a pending version below an applied one, so a branch
# that merges "under" main's max wedges every deployed
# database at startup — dev auto-deploys, so that wedge is
# immediate. (#65 landed V6 while V5 was still on a branch;
# this check would have forced the branch to renumber.)
main_max=$(git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- "$MIG" |
  grep -E '/V[0-9]+__[^/]+\.sql$' | sed -E 's:.*/V([0-9]+)__.*:\1:' | sort -n | tail -1)
comm -13 \
  <(git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- "$MIG" | grep -E '\.sql$' | sed 's:.*/::' | sort) \
  <(git ls-files -- "$MIG" | grep -E '\.sql$' | sed 's:.*/::' | sort) |
  grep -E '^V[0-9]+__' | sed -E 's/^V([0-9]+)__.*/\1 &/' | sort -n |
  awk -v max="$main_max" '
    $1 <= max { printf "::error::Migration %s is numbered at or below main'\''s newest (V%s); renumber above it\n", $2, max; bad = 1 }
    END { exit bad }'

with.filters:
webui:
  - "webui/**"
  # The OpenAPI spec is the wire contract the console
  # conforms to.
  - "server/src/main/resources/openapi/hoglake.yaml"
  # Cross-language vectors the console's own tests read:
  # partition decoding is implemented twice (server-side
  # for the partitions listing's filter and sort,
  # browser-side for the files tab), and the shared table
  # is what keeps the two equal. A change to it must run
  # BOTH suites, so it selects this workflow's jobs as well
  # as the server's.
  - "server/src/test/resources/vectors/**"
  - ".github/workflows/webui.yml"

steps.run: npm ci

steps.name: Typecheck + build
steps.run: npm run build

steps.name: Tests
steps.run: npm test

steps.name: Docker build + boot smoke
steps.run:
docker build -t hoglake-webui:ci webui/
# Static proxy_pass resolves the upstream name at boot; give
# nginx a resolvable alias so the smoke tests OUR config, not
# DNS.
docker network create smoke-net
# No upstream on purpose: runtime DNS resolution means the
# console must boot and probe green with the server absent
# (the gigahog first-sync ordering finding, hoglake#4).
docker run -d --name smoke --network smoke-net -p 8081:8080 hoglake-webui:ci
for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
  if curl -fsS -m 2 http://localhost:8081/health >/dev/null; then ok=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
docker logs smoke | tail -5
[ "${ok:-}" = "1" ]
# SPA still serves, and a proxied path fails soft (502/504
# from nginx), never a container crash.
curl -fsS -m 2 http://localhost:8081/ >/dev/null
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -m 5 -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8081/healthz)
echo "proxied /healthz without upstream -> $code"
case "$code" in 502|504) : ;; *) echo "expected 502/504"; exit 1 ;; esac
